rationale: All three lenses ran successfully. The blind lens raised a concern about the custom logo img alt change removing the accessible name, but both the edge-case lens (which read the source) and the acceptance lens confirmed the parent <a> carries aria-label='EPAM AI/Run Codemie logo' at line 69, making the img/SVGs correctly decorative. All four acceptance criteria pass. Commit format and branch name are valid. No security issues. 1 dismissed finding (blind lens false positive, refuted by two independent lenses).
